agentic_task.task:
1. On the index page, click the link 'Form Authentication'.
2. Type {username[0]} into the Username field.
3. Type {password[0]} into the Password field.
4. Click the Login button. You should land on the Secure Area page.
5. Navigate to https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/download
6. On the File Downloader page, click the first file link in the list to download it.
7. Stop once the download has been triggered. Do not log out and do not upload anything.
